priorityList: Maintain Arcane Intellect at all times.
Use Evocation before your primary burn phase to gain the damage buff and ensure maximum mana.
Cast Arcane Surge to initiate your main burn phase.
Cast Touch of the Magi immediately after Arcane Surge while the buff is active.
Use all offensive cooldowns (Trinkets, Potions, and Racials) during your Arcane Surge and Touch of the Magi window.
Spam Arcane Barrage while the Arcane Soul buff is active following your Arcane Surge.
Cast Arcane Barrage at 4 Arcane Charges if Touch of the Magi is about to expire to trigger the explosion.
Cast Arcane Barrage at 4 Arcane Charges once you reach 25 stacks of Arcane Salvo.
Cast Arcane Missiles with Clearcasting to build Arcane Salvo stacks, provided you are below 15 stacks.
Cast Arcane Orb if you have fewer than 2 Arcane Charges to quickly generate resources.
Cast Arcane Pulse (Glorious Incandescence) whenever 3 or more targets are present.
Use Arcane Explosion as your primary charge generator in AoE if you have fewer than 2 Arcane Charges and Arcane Orb is on cooldown.
Use Presence of Mind on Arcane Blast to quickly generate charges when Arcane Orb is unavailable.
Cast Arcane Blast as your filler spell to generate Arcane Charges when above 2 charges or in low-target situations.
Cast Arcane Barrage to consume 4 Arcane Charges if none of the specific Sunfury or burn conditions are met.
